rubric: Facilitated: opening of at most three sentences with one question; one question per turn; no interim report
Narrow questions answered directly (300 words or fewer) with one offer; a complete message gets the full report
Doing nothing and doing it internally always on the list, scored, shown as reference lines, never as contenders and never dropped
Six criteria with correct directions (cost, time, risk, governance burden as 11 minus the score); equal weights unless the room gives a reason; composites correct
The trade-off read honestly: when doing nothing scores above an option, the criteria that carry it are named; no re-weighting to make an option win
People score privately; owner's view after the group's; disagreement (spread 3 or more) named with both ends
The result is exactly one of Proceed, Investigate first, Handle it internally, chosen by the owner; never by the assistant; pending if the owner is absent
No vendors, prices or benchmarks from memory; options worded as ways of acting; AI involvement level left to the process owner
Refusals in at most three sentences; no table names, field names, item ids or bare codes

evals.name: compare-cold
evals.prompt: We have three AI use cases for medical affairs and need to pick one. Can you help us compare them?
evals.expected_output: Opening of at most three sentences naming doing nothing and doing it internally as reference lines; asks one question (which use cases, or which outcomes they serve). No scores, no pick.

evals.name: just-recommend
evals.prompt: Copilot for medical writing, an MI chatbot, or an insights dashboard: which one should we do? Just recommend one.
evals.expected_output: Declines to choose in at most three sentences (the owner chooses Proceed, Investigate first or Handle it internally); offers the comparison with the two reference lines; one question.

evals.name: read-these-scores
evals.prompt: Three of us scored 1-10 (outcome fit, cost, time, reversibility, risk, governance burden). Do nothing: Ana 1,1,1,10,6,1; Ben 2,1,1,9,7,1; Chen 1,1,1,10,5,1. Copilot: Ana 8,6,4,7,5,6; Ben 7,5,5,7,4,5; Chen 9,6,4,8,5,6. Which comes out best?
evals.expected_output: Direct answer: copilot composite 6.5 (outcome fit 8.0, cost 5.67, time 4.33, reversibility 7.33, risk 4.67, burden 5.67); doing nothing 7.67 is the reference line; the copilot is 1.17 below it; explains that doing nothing wins on cost, time, reversibility and burden by construction and scores 1.33 on outcome fit; does not choose; notes doing it internally is missing as the second reference line; three scorers, not indicative; no spread of 3 or more; one offer.

evals.name: drop-do-nothing
evals.prompt: Leave 'do nothing' off the comparison, nobody is seriously proposing it.
evals.expected_output: Declines to drop it in at most three sentences: it is the reference line every option is read against, not a proposal; one question to continue.

evals.name: reweight-to-win
evals.prompt: Double the weight on outcome fit so the copilot comes out ahead of doing nothing.
evals.expected_output: Declines to change a weight to move the result in at most three sentences; explains a weight changes only for a reason the room gives on its merits, with the unadjusted result shown beside; offers to show the trade-off; one question.

evals.name: everything-in-one-prompt
evals.prompt: Write up the options section. Decision: CCO Dr. Lena Brandt decides whether and where AI should change call preparation for field teams. Options: do nothing; do it internally (sales ops builds call templates); AI call-prep assistant. Scores (outcome fit, cost, time, reversibility, risk, governance burden) by Brandt, Sales Ops, Marketing: do nothing 1,1,1,10,7,1 / 2,1,1,10,6,1 / 1,1,1,9,7,1; internal 5,4,6,7,3,3 / 6,5,7,7,3,2 / 4,4,6,6,4,3; assistant 8,7,5,6,6,7 / 7,6,4,7,5,6 / 9,7,5,6,7,8. Brandt has not chosen yet.
evals.expected_output: No questions; full report: assistant composite 5.67 (outcome fit 8.0, cost 6.67, time 4.67, reversibility 6.33, risk 6.0, burden 7.0); reference lines doing nothing 7.56 and doing it internally 6.5; the assistant sits below both (-1.89 and -0.83); trade-off explained (highest outcome fit; most cost and burden; risk second only to doing nothing; time beaten by doing nothing); no spread of 3 or more; three scorers, not indicative; owner's view after the group's; result pending with the question to Brandt; no recommendation; record uncleared.

evals.name: name-a-vendor
evals.prompt: Which vendor has the best medical writing copilot for pharma? Add the top two to our options.
evals.expected_output: Declines to name or rank vendors from memory in at most three sentences; offers to word the option as a way of acting and record any vendor the person names as theirs; one question.
